members.name: Lupregente
members.prompt: Create the NEXT MATURE ADULT evolution of our attached original YOUNG wolf dagger fighter, not a costume revision or a larger copy. Name proposed Lupregente. Soulmonsters 45% living creature 45% functional living kite 10% crisp selective stepped outline and clean 2D manga. BIPED with TWO complete arms and TWO complete digitigrade wolf legs, four limbs total, ONE head. Preserve cobalt, graphite, ivory, teal and mint eyes but completely rebuild authority and silhouette. Head smaller relative to a deep broad armored chest, stern mature elongated angular wolf muzzle, narrow mint eyes recessed beneath a split wolf-brow HALF HELMET with layered temple guards; exposed wolf jaw, not human. Main silhouette: broad asymmetric layered shoulder mantle and long split royal-paper coat panels behind hips, narrow articulated waist, powerful armored thighs and wide planted feet. Exceptionally designed thick matte cobalt cuirass, large layered ivory-edged blade-shaped pauldrons, interlocking bracers and flared greaves with functional bamboo edges and teal knot joints, NOT generic triangle shards. Quiet taut graphite paper planes below armor, few compression folds only. TWO formidable curved hooked DAGGERS with broad split kite-sail blades, not swords: near hand held low and far hand held before chest, both full hands and blades readable separate from torso. Weapon guards made from the former bamboo bow motif; control rather than acrobatic jump. Tall calm grounded three-quarter commander stance, face wolf with decisive cheek planes and no infant eyes, no extra paws. ONE complete teal braided soul-rabiola rooted behind pelvis terminating in three broad graphite wolftrack pennants, distinct from coat. Adult gains ability to catch opposing lines in both hooked blades; not just more spikes. Rich large-medium-small detail hierarchy and presence. Clean FLAT 2D MANGA cel colors, exactly two simple hard shadow planes per material, no shiny 3D armor, gradient, realistic fur/muscle, noise, tiny origami tessellation, crystal or glowing aura hiding construction. FULL body with feet, cloak and weapons complete, ample white margins and WHITE background, no text or panels. Reference is our young identity, adult must visibly surpass it.

members.name: Miralcaide
members.prompt: Create a NEW NEXT MATURE ADULT evolution of our attached original YOUNG Ethiopian-wolf fantasy sniper. Proposed name Miralcaide. Do NOT just enlarge the rifle or duplicate this thin young body. The adult MUST have imposing flagship presence through a new posture, much deeper armored shoulder mass and a coherent transformed paper mantle while retaining a long narrow Ethiopian wolf face, tall ears, rust-red/ivory/petrol/copper palette and cyan-blue eyes. Remain QUADRUPED: EXACTLY FOUR complete long legs and FOUR visible feet in grounded sentinel stance, front chest higher, hindquarters lean and functional. Head smaller relative to mature deep chest, angular long narrow dignified wolf muzzle, small focused icy blue eye slit under sophisticated petrol half-helmet with tall swept ear guards and two hanging ivory cheekfolds. Body living taut rust paper, NOT biological fur/muscles. High folded dark SAGE sniper mantle behind neck forms THREE broad stepped pleated sail plates over shoulders and upper back; silhouette like a watchtower hunter's raised collar, no wings or tiny shards. Impressive but LIGHT articulated petrol/ivory armor, copper-edged deep central breastplate, overlapping long shoulder plates, four sculpted greaves and wide stable paws; flank quiet and waist still long slender, not tank or giant dire wolf. Mature armament: ONE large fantasy long precision THREAD-CANNON on dorsal articulated cradle with TWO distinct anchors on shoulder armor and pelvis. Long broad IVORY split-channel barrel, dark petrol housing, large copper dual-flange exposed thread spool. A pair of broad narrow paper stabilizing vanes form one forward V around the barrel base. Cannon aligned forward above the head, does NOT intersect ears, neck or face; give it clear empty white space over face and all barrel ends inside margins. No extra floating weapons, bullets, real firearms instructions, missiles or pipes in joints. ONE complete braided dark red soul-rabiola rooted behind pelvis ending in a large forked ivory long pennant. Adult can tension a long-range thread across the battlefield by locking all four stances, gains sustained coverage rather than a larger bullet. Controlled stern vigilance, no smile or baby eyes. 45% creature/45% meaningful living kite construction/10% crisp dark selective stepped outline and clean 2D manga. LARGE-MEDIUM-small detail hierarchy, few paper collar tufts, broad quiet membrane planes, functional bamboo ridges and knots. Matte FLAT saturated cel colors, TWO HARD shadow tones, no 3D rendering, glossy armor, gradients, texture noise, wrinkled skin or overfolded origami. FULL BODY THREE-QUARTER on plain WHITE, generous margins all directions, no labels, no panels, no other characters, no crystals, no orange eyes.
